selection_reasoning: The task 'find daylight_detector' is a clean, observable, and verifiable atomic task. The player must locate a daylight detector block placed somewhere in the scene. This task doesn't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — it's primarily a navigation and visual search task. It can be verified by checking whether the player is within a certain distance of the block or looking at it. As a single-task benchmark, no dependency edges are needed, but the scene design can make it interesting by placing the daylight detector in a non-trivial location (e.g., on a rooftop, inside a structure, or partially hidden) so the agent must explore and identify it.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate near the daylight detector and face toward it, confirming visual identification. The daylight detector is at spawn-relative [-5, 2, -1] on an oak fence post at eye level. max_distance=6 provides a small buffer beyond the ~5.1-5.5 block spawn distance so the player doesn't need to stand right on top of it, while still requiring deliberate approach. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the detector rather than just passing nearby.

scene_description: A flat grassy clearing with three distinct buildings arranged around the player spawn point: an oak planks building to the south-east (~8-12, ~0-4, ~8-12), a stone brick building to the north-west (~-10 to ~-6, ~0-3, ~-3 to ~-7), and a spruce planks building to the south-west (~-3 to ~1, ~0-3, ~10-14). A daylight detector is placed on top of an oak fence post at eye level (~-5, ~2, ~-1), positioned between the stone building and the spawn point. Additional landmarks include a crafting table (~5, ~0, ~0) and a stationary villager (~-3, ~0, ~3). The area is cleared of trees within a 15-block radius to ensure navigability.
task_text: Find the daylight detector hidden somewhere in this small village area. Look around the buildings and structures carefully.
design_notes: Daylight detector at (~-5, ~2, ~-1) on oak fence post is ~5.5 blocks from spawn — close enough to be findable but requires the player to turn and look in the correct direction. Three buildings create visual landmarks and exploration targets. The stone brick building is nearest to the detector, creating a natural exploration path. The cleared area ensures no tree obstruction. Buildings have door openings for interior exploration as distractors.
